title: The Moon Knocks on the Tiger's Door
skyStory: The new moon crosses into Aries, two percent lit and already pacing. It has arrived in Joel's sign and immediately starts rearranging the furniture. Mars, ruler of Aries, flings open the door with both arms. Finally, someone with energy. They high-five so hard a comet changes lanes. Saturn, watching from the mountain, quietly hides the good china.

reading: The moon is in your house now, and it brought snacks and a megaphone. Expect to feel like starting things. Lots of things. You may feel a strong urge to announce a new project to everyone you meet. Pick one person. Tell only them.

Courage comes easily under an Aries moon, so spend it on something brave but small: the email you keep rewriting, the question you swallowed in last week's meeting, the shelf you meant to hang in January. The [[The Chariot]] is not in the official spread, but it showed up anyway, wheels spinning, ready to go. Point it at one thing and let the Tiger drive.
joel.mission: Send the message you have been rewriting in your head for days, exactly as it is right now, typos and all.
joel.omen: A red door, a red car or a red scarf before noon. It means the moon has your back in your own sign.
joel.stoneWhy: her stone holds your fire steady

reading: The moon has gone off to visit Joel's sign, which means the energy around you is suddenly very bouncy. People will interrupt more. Phones will ping more. The Wood Rat finds a high branch and watches the circus with an amused face.

Your ruby, Joel's stone, will feel especially warm on your pinky today, like it knows the moon is visiting home. Let a little of that Aries fire borrow your hands. Say yes to one bold, tiny thing: wearing the louder sweater, telling the story with the bigger finish, taking the seat at the front instead of the back. The mountain can be loud for an afternoon. It will still be a mountain tomorrow.
nancy.mission: Choose the bolder option on one small choice today, like a brighter colour or the front seat, and own it completely.
nancy.omen: A ram, a goat, or anything with horns on a sign or screen. It means borrowed fire is working in your favour.

together.text: Aries moon dare: each of you do one thing today that makes your heart beat a little faster, nothing risky, just brave. Report back tonight with a single sentence that starts with the words I actually did it.
